packageRules.description: Disabled by default — this Renovate config is scoped to the @orangecheck/* family ONLY. Third-party deps (react, typescript, wxt, @types/*, prettier) are NOT auto-tracked here; bump them by hand when you choose to. This repo previously shipped NO renovate.json at all, and the global config's requireConfig:'optional' meant Renovate fell back to its defaults and tracked everything — nine stale third-party PRs accumulated from June onward, against the family rule.

@orangecheck/* patch + minor, bundled into one PR per consumer after a 1-day stability window. Renovate does not merge it: its fine-grained token cannot read GitHub Actions check runs, so it would merge on Vercel's status alone. This repo's own CI merges the PR once its gating jobs pass (merge-renovate).
Human-review @orangecheck/* major bumps — these change wire shape.
